messages:
harper: Quick thread to finalize the v1 -> v2 migration doc and the short deprecation banner. Draft PR: https://redwood.dev/r/5234. Need decisions on header name, redirect behavior for POSTs, and tiny SDK examples for TS/Python/Go.

ida: Recommend header `X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1`. For POSTs we should 307 (preserve method); GETs can be 301. Also add a short FAQ about clients that don't auto-follow redirects.

leo: I'll add small TS/Python/Go snippets showing both `apiVersion: 'v2'` and `compat: true` usage. Compat should log a single warning and is time-limited (~90 days). Example TS: `const c = new Redwood({apiVersion:'v2'}); await c.models.list();` and `new Redwood({compat:true})` for shim.

sre-bot: Staging infra note: redirect rule applied to /v1/* -> /v2/*, preserving method + querystring. Tests show Location header + X-Redwood-Deprecated present; patching one case that dropped auth.

harper: can we include a curl example that demonstrates Location + header? add to "server behavior" section. e.g.: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -d '{"name":"x"}'` should show `HTTP/1.1 307`, `Location: /v2/models`, `X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1`. Also mention that client libraries will re-POST when following the 307.

ida: I'll update the banner copy: "Notice: v1 API deprecated. Migrate to v2 — see migration guide." with link to breaking-changes anchor. Keep it short.

leo: owners: @ida banner + migration copy, @leo SDK snippets + examples, infra to finish redirect patch. I'll open quickstart PRs for hardcoded /v1/ links and matrix them for review.

docs-bot: PR #5234 opened by @harper in docs-staging. Please review by EOD.
